comment: The agent manifest. A static host cannot list a directory, so this file IS the directory listing: add a folder under public/agents/ and add its name here, or the app will never fetch it. One entry, and that is the design rather than a starting point — `main` is the agent, and the jobs that used to be separate agents are stages of its own loop. Compaction builds its own sheet (crates/agent/src/window.rs), and the critique is the `critique` stage.
